summary: Sold out of the crab? Take a special off the site in seconds.
content:
1. In the sidebar on the far left, select the **Collections** icon, then **Specials**.
2. Select the special to open it.
3. Change **Ends** to yesterday's date.
4. Scroll to the bottom and select **Save**.

The special comes off the website right away. It stays in your list, so when it comes back next season, you only need to change the dates.

No specials running? The Today's Specials box hides itself, so the home page never looks empty.
title: End a special early
author: Sam Keller
